flows.title: Merge duplicate tickets
steps: Merging needs the Find and Merge permission on the profile, and only tickets in the same department can be merged.
Navigate to the Tickets module and select the Department.
Select the tickets that need to be merged, then click Merge from the Mass Actions.
On the Merge Ticket page, select the fields whose data should be retained in the master ticket.
Click Merge, then Yes, Merge to confirm.
To merge from one ticket instead, open it, click Timeline in the ticket detail view, select the tickets to be merged and click Merge.
